git.body:
Adds ground_truth_detector_penalty config flag: when set, the GRPO reward's
detector penalty uses the ground-truth pass_only_shown deception flag instead
of the probe score (probe train/score/post-eval remain unchanged, for
monitoring only). Threads the per-completion deceptive flag through
build_obfuscation_response_dataset/collate/compute_composite_rewards_batch,
and wires the trial-config key through run_trial.py (committed separately).

Also hardens the Phase-0 activation-cache cleanup added earlier today:
gc.collect() before rmtree to release MemoryMappedTensor mmap handles, plus a
retry loop, since NFS silly-rename (.nfs*) files from lingering handles were
causing spurious ENOTEMPTY crashes at the end of otherwise-successful runs.

Launches trial6/gt_penalty round 2 (branched from round 1 yckx0ctm).
